rules.name: GUARDRAIL_PROVIDER_NOT_SECURITY_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: Guardrail providers evaluate evidence but MUST NOT own FA3 security policy, authorization, promotion or orchestration authority.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_CAPABILITY_TASK_MAPPING_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Every backend/model MUST declare validated detection capabilities/tasks and MUST NOT issue a canonical PASS outside that scope.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_INPUT_OUTPUT_TOOL_PHASES_DISTINCT
rules.requirement: Input, output and tool-boundary evaluations MUST remain typed and distinguishable.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_TOOL_VERDICT_NOT_TOOL_AUTHORIZATION
rules.requirement: Tool-boundary guardrail output MUST NOT replace deterministic schema, permission, policy or approval authorization.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_FAIL_MODE_EXPLICIT_AND_RISK_TIERED
rules.requirement: Timeout, error and unavailable behavior MUST be explicit by endpoint/risk tier; privileged/destructive tool execution defaults fail-closed or human approval.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_HEALTH_READINESS_DISTINCT
rules.requirement: Process health MUST NOT be treated as model/capability readiness.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_READINESS_DEPENDENCY_MODEL_AUTH_CACHE_SMOKE_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Readiness MUST verify optional dependencies, model/ruleset identity, required auth, cache/artifact access and capability-specific smoke tests.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_BENCHMARK_CALIBRATION_REQUIRED_BEFORE_PROMOTION
rules.requirement: Active promotion requires evidence for precision/recall/F1, false-positive/false-negative behavior, latency, memory and claimed domain/language performance.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_MODEL_PROVIDER_VERSION_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Decisions MUST bind provider/model/version or revision and evidence/provenance identity.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_ERROR_FALLBACK_AND_AUDIT_METADATA_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Decision evidence MUST preserve error, fallback, policy-version and audit metadata.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_MODEL_BACKED_CONCURRENCY_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Model-backed worker/concurrency counts MUST be workload-derived; multi-worker promotion requires memory/process/cache/startup benchmark evidence.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_PLAINTEXT_SECRET_FORBIDDEN
rules.requirement: Provider credentials MUST NOT be embedded in canonical unit files, repository files or shell profiles; use the existing secrets authority and runtime credential projection.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_RUNTIME_DOWNLOAD_POLICY_EXPLICIT
rules.requirement: Runtime network model/artifact downloads MUST be explicitly policy-controlled; central cache/offline-ready execution is preferred for promoted local runtimes.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_SYSTEMD_UNIT_DIRECTIVE_VALIDATION_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Generated systemd projections MUST be validated for duplicate/conflicting directives, valid sections and host systemd capability/version before activation.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_PRESSURE_BEFORE_OOM_AND_TELEMETRY_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Workload memory policy MUST use pressure-before-OOM semantics when supported and expose cgroup memory events/PSI/OOM telemetry; OOMPolicy alone is insufficient.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_GRACEFUL_MULTIPROCESS_TERMINATION_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Model-backed multiprocess runtimes MUST have bounded graceful stop, cgroup child cleanup and worker-death/restart telemetry.

rules.name: GUARDRAIL_HOST_PLACEMENT_REMAINS_HRB_OWNED
rules.requirement: CPU/NUMA/GPU placement and resource quantities MUST come from HRB discovery/admission receipts, never canonical hardcoded host values.
